rules: Be kind. No harassment, hate or personal attacks.
Keep public spaces safe for work.
Respect privacy: don't share other people's details, photos or messages.
Credit art: share only your own work as your own. No AI-generated images in the gallery.
No spam, advertising or unsolicited messages.
Follow Discord's and VRChat's rules, here and on Discord.
Staff have the final word. Questions? Ask a Control Room Moderator.
submitGuide: Join our Discord (the link above) and post your own picture in #gallery-submissions, or type /submit.
PNG or JPG; square pictures suit the frames best.
Put the title on the first line, and your artist name if it differs from your Discord name.
Only your own work, please. No AI-generated images.
A curator looks at every picture, and H.E.A.R.T.H. 9000 tells you the outcome on Discord.
